clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Elling Trias sends a sealed note to Watcher Backus in Duskwood. He asks the Night Watch guard to report Defias activity near Darkshire.

Elling Trias agrees to use his contacts to help search for the missing diplomat. He seals a note for Watcher Backus, a Night Watch guard stationed in Duskwood. Trias sends a traveler south through the forest to deliver it by hand. He hopes Backus will report any Defias seen near Darkshire.
